name: VybeOS
description:
VybeOS is an AI marketing platform for planning, generating, and publishing on-brand content across channels. This connector lets Claude work directly with your VybeOS brands, campaigns, and content.

With it, you can:
• Browse your brands, campaigns, content outputs, products, platform types, connected channels, and past publications.
• Create a campaign and author its narrative — theme, key messages, tone, story arc, and per-phase narratives.
• Add blank content slots to a campaign and write or edit the copy for each platform type.
• Start generation jobs (topics, personas, products) and check or cancel their status.
• Review publication and campaign performance metrics.
• Search across your content and fetch a specific item.

Access uses OAuth 2.1 and is scoped to the signed-in user's brand permissions: read tools only list and retrieve data, and any tool that creates or changes content is explicitly marked. Claude only ever sees and edits what your VybeOS account is allowed to.

_published_faq.name: How do I add VybeOS to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add VybeOS to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.vybeos.co/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the VybeOS MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: VybeOS lists 23 MCP tools, including fetch, search, vybe_add_content_output, vybe_create_campaign, vybe_describe_campaign_input, vybe_edit_content_output_content, vybe_generate, vybe_get_campaign, vybe_get_campaign_narrative, vybe_get_content_output, vybe_list_brands, and vybe_list_campaigns.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to VybeOS?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to VybeOS in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
VybeOS requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
VybeOS is developed by VybeOS. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
